name: What Build-Ready Means
title: What Build-Ready Means
description: Build-ready means a competent builder with standard tools can produce a correct product from the record alone - no phone calls, no guesses, no tribal knowledge. It is a high bar, deliberately.
how_it_works: Test the definition: hand the record to someone unfamiliar and watch where they stall or guess. Every stall is a readiness defect. Fix the record, not the builder.
key_points: Buildable by a competent stranger with standard tools.
No calls, guesses, or tribal knowledge required.
The stranger test reveals readiness defects.
Fix the record, never blame the builder.
requirements: A candidate build-ready record package; defined completeness criteria; validation checklist for the record type.
standards: Documentation completeness practice; engineering release procedures.
citations: ASME Y14.100 engineering drawing practices - complete definition.
